name: managing-acute-stroke
description: Reviews acute stroke care for one encounter and drafts a coordination, documentation and quality review for clinician and stroke-coordinator sign-off. Builds a timestamp ledger and clock block: last known well (LKW) versus symptom discovery, wake-up stroke, arrival, door-to-needle (DTN), door-in-door-out (DIDO) and door-to-puncture. Compares care with the AHA/ASA 2026 acute ischemic stroke guideline (alteplase or tenecteplase within 4.5 hours, extended-window imaging selection, blood pressure before and after thrombolysis, thrombectomy windows including large core and basilar occlusion, NIHSS, dysphagia screen) and the 2022 ICH guideline (blood pressure, anticoagulant reversal), and keeps that apart from Joint Commission STK-4, CSTK-01, CSTK-04 and STK-OP-1 abstraction and Target: Stroke goals. Flags outdated contraindication lists, late NIHSS, FDA label conflicts and transfer delays. Use for stroke alert review, stroke measure abstraction, code stroke audit or stroke documentation gaps. No patient orders.
